faq: Which precast products can this solution support?

The proposed configurations cover solid walls, insulated sandwich wall panels, lattice girder slabs and selected special precast elements. We confirm compatibility from your product drawings, dimensions and reinforcement details.
Should we choose a carousel line or a long-line solution?
The choice depends on product repetition, output targets, available space and the work required at each station. We review the product mix and production flow before recommending a configuration.
What determines the cost of a precast plant?

Cost depends on the product range, capacity, automation, curing, handling, reinforcement preparation and site interfaces. Your proposal separates equipment and services from civil works, local utilities and other project costs.
What information is needed for a plant proposal?

Start with your project country, intended products and output target. Product drawings, shift plans, building dimensions, crane capacity and available utilities help us prepare a more useful review. If some information is unavailable, we can clarify it with you.
Can REALJET help upgrade an existing plant?
Yes. We can review your existing layout, equipment interfaces and production bottlenecks to assess suitable upgrades. The scope is defined after checking the current system and the changes required.
Can production equipment connect with our software?

MES, equipment data collection and other digital modules can be considered as part of the project. Interfaces, software language, deployment and integration with existing systems require technical confirmation.
What installation and training are included?
Installation, commissioning, training and support are defined in the agreed package. We identify site preparation, customer responsibilities and local contractor work before implementation.

We assess capacity using the product mix, pallet or bed arrangement, station cycle times, shifts, curing and handling limits. Preliminary figures are planning assumptions until project conditions and acceptance criteria are agreed.
